newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Drunk pays extra duty for airline tipple.
newsitem.headline: Drunk pays extra duty for airline tipple.

text.p: A Kuwaiti court fined an airline passenger for arriving drunk after dismissing pleas from his lawyer that the offence of drinking alcohol was committed abroad, the Arab Times newspaper reported on Tuesday.
The Court of Misdemeanours waived a sentence of a month in prison but imposed a 50 dinar ($165) fine on the unnamed defendant.
His lawyer said the offence was committed in Dubai, rather than Kuwait.
